comment: Known var(--x) reads, written file|--property, that have no fallback and no definition anywhere
(styles.css, dashboard-workflows.css, index.html and the renderer's JavaScript). Each one makes
its declaration invalid at computed-value time, so the property silently falls back to
This list only shrinks. Never add to it: define the property, give the var() a fallback, or use
the token that exists. When you fix an entry the test fails until you delete its line here.
